शंस् vt. 1U (pp. शस्त; pres. शंसति; pass. शस्यते) 1. To relate, to tell, to report, to announce, to communicate to, (with dat. or gen. of the person communicated to), न मे ह्रिया शंसति किंचिदीप्सितं स्पृहावती वस्तुषु केषु मागधी R.iii.5, xi.84, M.iii.109, vii.116, K.S.v.51, iii.60; 2. to indicate, to suggest, पीडाभाजः कुसुमचिताः साशंसं शंसंत्यस्मिन् सुरतविशेषं शय्याः Kir.v.23; 3. to praise, to approve, संन्यासं कर्मणां कृष्ण पुनर्योगं च शंससि Bg.v.1; 4. to hurt, to injure.With अभि-, to curse, M.viii.116.With आ-, (in the Atm., शंसतेरपेक्षायामात्मनेपदमिष्यते Mall. on R.xiv.50) 1. to hope, to expect, जितेंद्रिये शूलिनि पुष्पचापः स्वकार्यसिद्धिं पुनराशशंसे K.S.iii.57, आशंसंते समितिषु सुराः सक्तवैरा हि दैत्यैरस्याधिज्ये धनुषिविजयं पौरुहूते च वज्रे Sak.ii.; 2. to desire, to wish, राज्ञः शिवं सावरजस्य भूयादित्याशशंसे करणैरबाह्यैः R.xiv.50, संग्रामं चाशशंसिरे Bt.xiv.70; 3. (Par.) to tell, to relate, to speak of, आशंसता बाणगतिं वृषांके कार्यं त्वया नः प्रतिपन्नकल्पम् K.S.iii.14.With प्र-, to praise, to extol, to approve, to speak highly of, प्राशंसीत्तं निशाचरः Bt.xii.65, हरिणा युवतिः प्रशशंसे Git.G.i., M.x.33, vii.64.

शंक् vt. or vi. 1Ā (pp. शंकित; pres. शंकते) 1. To doubt, to be uncertain, to hesitate, e.g. शंके जीवति वा न वा; 2. to fear, to dread, to be afraid, नाशंकिष्ट विवस्वतः Bt.xv.39; 3. to suspect, to think probable, to believe, शंकस्व संकेतनिकेतमाप्ताः Na.xxii.42, Bt.iii.26; 4. to propound a doubt or objection, न च ब्रह्मणः प्रमाणांतरगम्यत्वं शंकितुं शक्यम् Sar.D. With अभि-, to doubt, to be doubtful, M.viii.96.With आ-, 1. to fear, to suspect, to think, to believe, यतश्च भयमाशंकेत् M.vii.188, आशंकसे यदग्निं तदिदं स्पर्शक्षमं रत्नम् Sak.i.; 2. to expect, भरतागमनं पुनः । आशंक्योत्सुकसारंगां चित्रकूटस्थलीं जहौ R.xii.24; 3. to entertain doubts about, Bt.xxi.1.With परि-, 1. to doubt, to entertain doubts about; 2. to suspect, to believe, पत्रेऽपि संचारिणि प्राप्तं त्वां परिशंकते Git.G.vi.With वि-, to fear, to suspect, to entertain suspicions about, विशंकते भीरु यतोऽवधीरणाम् Sak.iii., जनोऽभ्यथा भर्तृमतीं विशंकते v.

संसर्ग-दोष m. the fault or evil consequences arising from the society of bad people.
संसर्जन n. 1. Abandoning, leaving; 2. voiding.
संसर्प m. 1. Creeping along, any gentle motion; 2. the intercalary month occurring in a year in which there falls a kshayamāsa.
संसर्पण n. 1. The act of creeping along; 2. an unexpected attack, surprise.
संसाद m. An assembly.

संसार m. 1. Course, passage; 2. the course or circuit of mundane existence, the world, असारं संसारं परिमुषितरत्नं त्रिभुवनम् M.M.v.; 3. a succession of births or existences, e.g. संसारेषु विचित्रेशु पच्यमानाः स्वकर्मभिः or परिवर्तिनि संसारे मृतः को वा न जायते Hit.i.; 4. transmigration, meta-empsychosis; 5. worldly illusion; 6. secular life, worldly pursuit, कंसारिरपि संसारवासनाबद्धशृंखलाम् Git.G.iii.
संसार-गुरु m. an epithet of the god of love.
संसार-मार्ग m. 1. mundane existence, the world; 2. the vulva.
संसार-मोक्ष m. liberation or emancipation from worldly existence.
संसारिन् m. The individual soul.
संसिद्ध a. (f. द्धा) One who has obtained final beatitude. See सिद्ध.
संसिद्ध a. (f. द्धा) One who has obtained final beatitude. See सिद्ध.

संसिद्धि f. 1. Complete accomplishment, e.g. स्वनुष्ठितस्य धर्मस्य संसिद्धिर्हरितोषणम्; 2. final emancipation, कर्मणैव हि संसिद्धिमास्थिता जनकादयः Bg.iii.20; 3. natural disposition or quality; 4. a passionate or intoxicated woman.
संसूचन n. 1. The act of showing plainly or proving; 2. telling, informing; 3. hinting, insinuating; 4. reproaching.
संसृति f. 1. Course, current, flow; 2. transmigration, किं मां निपातयसि संसृतिगर्तमध्ये Bh.V.iv.32; 3. the course of the world, the world. See संसार.
संसृष्ट a. (f. ष्टा) 1. Commingled, mixed together, united; 2. composed; 3. associated or connected together as partners; 4. involved; 5. clothed in clean garments; 6. created.
संसृष्ट a. (f. ष्टा) 1. Commingled, mixed together, united; 2. composed; 3. associated or connected together as partners; 4. involved; 5. clothed in clean garments; 6. created.
संसृष्ट-त्व n. 1. union; 2. voluntary reunion in interest of father and son or of brothers, after partition of property (in law).
संसृष्ट-ता f. 1. union; 2. voluntary reunion in interest of father and son or of brothers, after partition of property (in law).

संसृष्टि f. 1. Union, combination; 2. association, intercourse, co-partnership; 3. collection, assembly; 4. voluntary reunion in interest after partition (in law); 5. the aggregation of two or more independent figures of speech in one and the ksame passage (in rhetoric). (It is thus defined in the S.D.- मिथोनपेक्शयैतेषां (i.e. पूर्वोक्तशब्दार्थालंकाराणाम्) स्थितिः संसृष्टिरुच्यते x.).
संस्कर्तृ m. 1. One who initiates; 2. one who dresses (as food), संस्कर्ता चोपहर्ता च खादकश्चेति घातकाः M.v.51.

संस्कार m. 1. Forming well or thoroughly; 2. refining, polishing, मणिः प्रयुक्तसम्स्कारः R.iii.18; 3. embellishment, decoration, e.g. स्वभावसुंदरं वस्तु न संस्कारमपेक्षते; 4. forming of the mind, education, संस्कारपूतेन वरं वरेण्यं सरस्वती (नुनाव) K.S.vii.90; 5. a purificatory rite, निषेकादिर्द्विजन्मना कार्यः शरीरसंस्कारः M.ii.26. (Manu enjoins twelve purificatory rites at ii.27; others enumerate sixteen); 6. a ceremony in general; 7. investiture with the sacred cord, M.iii.43; 8. the consecration of a thing; 9. obsequies; 10. preparation (as of an article of food or medicine, e.g. सूदान्संस्कारकुशलान्); 11. impression, form, mould, e.g. यन्नवे भाजने लग्नेः संस्कारो नान्यथा भवेत्; 12. the self-productive quality; (three Sanskāras are recognized in the Vaiśeṣika philosophy, viz., भावना, वेग and स्थितिस्थापकता); 13. apprehension, conception; 14. resolution, अहो स्थिरसंस्कारा व्यवहारार्थिनः Mrich.ix.
संस्कार-वर्जित a. one over whom the purificatory rites are not performed.

संस्कृत (I) a. (f. ता) 1. Carefully or accurately formed, artificially fabricated; 2. refined, trained, adorned, वाण्येका समलंकरोति पुरुषं या संस्कॄता धार्यते Bhartr.ii.19; 3. made ready, dressed, cooked; 4. consecrated, hallowed; 5. married; 6. excellent, best.
संस्कृत (II) m. 1. A word formed accurately according to rules, a regular derivative; 2. a man of one of the three higher castes who has received all the purificatory rites; 3. a learned man.
संस्कृत (III) n. 1. The Sanskrit language; 2. offering, oblation, sacrifice.

संस्कृत (I) a. (f. ता) 1. Carefully or accurately formed, artificially fabricated; 2. refined, trained, adorned, वाण्येका समलंकरोति पुरुषं या संस्कॄता धार्यते Bhartr.ii.19; 3. made ready, dressed, cooked; 4. consecrated, hallowed; 5. married; 6. excellent, best.
संस्क्रिया f. 1. Any purificatory rite; 2. funeral ceremonies.
संस्तंभ m. 1. Support, prop; 2. confirming, fixing; 3. stop, stay; 4. paralysis.
संस्तर m. 1. A couch, a bed, नवपल्लवसंस्तरेऽपि ते मृदु दूयेत यदंगमर्पितम् R.viii.57, K.S.iv.34; 2. sacrifice.
संस्तव m. 1. Praise; 2. acquaintance, familiarity, गुणाः प्रियत्वेऽधिकृता न संस्तवः Kir.iv.25, संस्तवस्थिरं तिरोहितं प्रेम घनागमश्रियः iv.22.
संस्ताव m. 1. Hymning chorus; 2. the place for reciting hymns at a sacrifice; 3. praise, celebration.
संस्तुत a. (f. ता) 1. Praised, applauded; 2. agreeing together; 3. familiar, acquainted, (pp. of स्तु with सम् q.v.).
संस्तुत a. (f. ता) 1. Praised, applauded; 2. agreeing together; 3. familiar, acquainted, (pp. of स्तु with सम् q.v.).
संस्तुति f. Praise.
संस्त्याय m. 1. Assemblage, heap; 2. vicinity; 3. spreading, expansion, diffusion; 4. a habitation, a house, अथवा संस्त्यायमेव गच्छावः M.M.i.
संस्थ (I) a. (f. स्था) 1. Associated, domesticated; 2. staying, abiding, lasting; 3. stationary, fixed; 4. ended, perished, dead; 5. situated, न केवलं दरीसंस्थं … … अपास्तं मे परं तमः K.S.vi.60.
संस्थ (II) m. 1. An inhabitant; 2. a countryman; 3. a spy.
संस्थ (I) a. (f. स्था) 1. Associated, domesticated; 2. staying, abiding, lasting; 3. stationary, fixed; 4. ended, perished, dead; 5. situated, न केवलं दरीसंस्थं … … अपास्तं मे परं तमः K.S.vi.60.

संस्था f. 1. An assembly; 2. a state or condition of being, situation; 3. occupation, business, सर्वेषां तु स नामानि … पृथक् संस्थाय निर्ममे M.i.21; 4. correct conduct; 5. stop, stay; 6. a royal ordinance; 7. end; 8. loss, destruction, death; 9. universal destruction; 10. resemblance.

संस्थान n. 1. A heap, a quantity; 2. the aggregation of primitive atoms; 3. configuration; 4. fabrication, construction; 5. common place of abode; 6. vicinity; 7. a place where four roads meet; 8. position (in Vedānta philosophy); 9. a mark, sign, e.g. सास्नादिसंस्थानविशेषो लिंगम्; 10. death; 11. form, figure, disguise, चारैश्चानैकसंस्थानैः प्रोत्साह्य वशमानयेत् M.ix.261.
संस्थापन n. 1. The act of placing together, collecting; 2. restraining; 3. establishment; 4. regulation, fixing, कुर्वीत चैषां प्रत्यक्षमर्घसंस्थापनं नृपः M.viii.422.
संस्थापना f. Restraining, curbing, bringing back, संस्थापना प्रियतरा विरहातुराणाम् Mrich.iii.
संस्थित a. (f. ता) 1. Contiguous; 2. resembling; 3. settled, fixed; 4. placed in; 5. stationary; 6. completed, ended; 7. dead, (pp. of स्था with सम् q.v.).
संस्थित a. (f. ता) 1. Contiguous; 2. resembling; 3. settled, fixed; 4. placed in; 5. stationary; 6. completed, ended; 7. dead, (pp. of स्था with सम् q.v.).

संस्थिति f. 1. Staying together; 2. accumulation, heap; 3. contiguity; 4. abiding, abode, यथा नदीनदाः सर्वे सागरे यांति संस्थितिम् । तथैवाश्रमिणः सर्वे गृहस्थे यांति संस्थितिम् M.vi.90; 5. duration; 6. condition of life; 7. restraint; 8. death.
संस्पर्श m. 1. Contact, mixture; 2. perception, sense; 3. the being touched.
संस्पर्शी f. A kind of fragrant plant.
संस्फाल m. A cloud.
संस्फेट n. war, battle.
संस्फोट m. war, battle.
संस्मृति f. Remembrance, recollection, तव संस्मृतिर्भव भवत्यभवाय Kir.xviii.27.

संहत a. (f. ता) 1. Stuck together; 2. well-knit, compact; 3. closely allied, Kir.i.19; 4. keeping or striving together; 5. united, assembled, संहतास्तु हरंतीमे जालं मम विहंगमाः Hit.i.; 6. struck, wounded.

संहत a. (f. ता) 1. Stuck together; 2. well-knit, compact; 3. closely allied, Kir.i.19; 4. keeping or striving together; 5. united, assembled, संहतास्तु हरंतीमे जालं मम विहंगमाः Hit.i.; 6. struck, wounded.
संहात m. One of the twenty-one hells, M.iv.89.
संहत-जानु a. knock-kneed.
संहत-ता f. 1. close approximation, contact; 2. compactness; 3. combination; 4. union, agreement.
संहत-त्व n. 1. close approximation, contact; 2. compactness; 3. combination; 4. union, agreement.
संहत-भ्रू a. knitting the brows.
संहत-स्तनी f. a woman with contiguous breasts.

संहति f. 1. Combination, union, संहतिः श्रेयसी पुंसाम् Hit.i.; 2. assemblage, heap, multitude, लघयता शारदंबुदसंहतिम् Kir.v.4; 3. bulk, गुरुतां नयंति हि गुणा न संहतिः Kir.xii.10; 4. compactness, inflexibility; 5. strength; 6. the body; 7. agreement.
संहनन n. (See संहति above), e.g. सर्वसंहननोपेतं सिंहसंहननौजसम्.
संहरण n. 1. Collecting, gathering; 2. restraining; 3. taking; 4. destroying.
संहर्ष m. 1. Pleasure, joy; 2. horripilation; 3. emulation, rivalry; 4. wind.

संहार m. 1. Drawing together, gathering, collection (as in वेणीसंहार); 2. contraction, withdrawal, संहारविक्षेपलघुक्रियेण R.v.45, 57; 3. restraining; 4. destruction of the world; 5. a fault in pronunciation; 6. close, end, conclusion; 7. a charm or spell for restraining a magical weapon; 8. name of a hell; 9. practice, skill.
संहार-मुद्रा f. name of a particular posture in Tantra worship; (it is thus defined- अध्मुखे वामहस्ते ऊर्ध्वास्यं दक्षहस्तकम् । क्षिप्त्वांगुलीरंगुलीभिः संगृह्य परिवर्तयेत्).
संहित a. (f. ता) 1. Placed together, united; 2. conformable to, in accordance with; 3. equipped, provided; 4. caused by, (pp. of धा with सम् q.v.).
संहित a. (f. ता) 1. Placed together, united; 2. conformable to, in accordance with; 3. equipped, provided; 4. caused by, (pp. of धा with सम् q.v.).

संहिता f. 1. Conjunction, combination; 2. collection, compilation, compendium; 3. any methodical collection of texts or verses; 4. the real continuous hymnical text of the Veda as formed out of the Padas, or separate words by proper phonetic changes according to various schools; (it is thus defined- पदप्रकृतिः संहिता); 5. a compilation or compendium of laws, a code, a digest; 6. the junction or combination of letters according to euphonic rules (in grammar). (It is thus defined- वर्णानामनेकप्राणयोगः संहिता); 7. the supreme being.
संहूति f. Clamour, tumultuous exclamation.
संहृत a. (f. ता) 1. Withdrawn, अभिमुखो मयि संहृतमीक्षितम् Sak.ii.; 2. seized, laid hold of; 3. restrained, curbed.
संहृत a. (f. ता) 1. Withdrawn, अभिमुखो मयि संहृतमीक्षितम् Sak.ii.; 2. seized, laid hold of; 3. restrained, curbed.
संहृति f. 1. Contraction, compression; 2. destruction, loss; 3. connection; 4. taking, seizure.
संहृष्ट a. (f. ष्टा) 1. Thrilled with joy; 2. bristling; 3. fired with emulation.
संहृष्ट a. (f. ष्टा) 1. Thrilled with joy; 2. bristling; 3. fired with emulation.
संह्राद m. A loud noise, an uproar.
संह्रीण a. (f. णा) Modest, bashful.
संह्रीण a. (f. णा) Modest, bashful.
संकट (I) a. (f. टा) 1. Contracted, narrow, strait; 2. impassable, impervious; 3. crowded, full of, beset with, संकटा ह्याहिताग्नीनां प्रत्यवायै गृहस्थता Ut.i.
संकट (II) n. 1. A narrow passage; 2. strait, difficulty, trouble, e.g. संकटेषु परीक्ष्यते प्राज्ञाः शूराश्च संगरे.
संकट (I) a. (f. टा) 1. Contracted, narrow, strait; 2. impassable, impervious; 3. crowded, full of, beset with, संकटा ह्याहिताग्नीनां प्रत्यवायै गृहस्थता Ut.i.
संकथा f. Conversation.
संकर्षण (I) n. 1. The act of drawing together, contracting; 2. attracting; 3. ploughing.
संकर्षण (II) m. An epithet of Balarāma, (संकर्षणा तु गर्भस्य स तु संकर्षणो युवा).
संकलन n. 1. The act of heaping together; 2. contact, junction, collision; 3. blending, twining; 4. addition (in math.).
संकलना f. 1. The act of heaping together; 2. contact, junction, collision; 3. blending, twining; 4. addition (in math.).
संकलित a. (f. ता) 1. Heaped up, piled; 2. blended together, intermixed; 3. laid hold of; 4. added.
संकलित a. (f. ता) 1. Heaped up, piled; 2. blended together, intermixed; 3. laid hold of; 4. added.

संकल्प m. 1. Will, volition, mental resolve, resolution; 2. wish, desire, e.g. यस्य सर्वे समाचाराः कामसकल्पवर्जिताः; 3. thought, idea, reflection, अर्थाः संकल्पकल्पाः Bhartr.ii.82; 4. imagination, fancy, contrivance, वृथेव संकल्पशतेरजस्रमनंग नीतोऽसि मयाभिवृद्धिम् Sak.iii.; 5. mind; 6. solemn vow; 7. expectation of advantage from a holy work.
संकल्प-जन्मन्, -योनि m. an epithet of the god of love, संकल्पयोनिरभिमानभूतम् K.S.iii.24.
संकल्प-जन्मन्, -योनि m. an epithet of the god of love, संकल्पयोनिरभिमानभूतम् K.S.iii.24.
संकसुक a. (f. का) 1. Unsteady, fickle, changeable; 2. doubtful, uncertain; 3. weak, feeble; 4. wicked, bad.
संकसुक a. (f. का) 1. Unsteady, fickle, changeable; 2. doubtful, uncertain; 3. weak, feeble; 4. wicked, bad.
संकाश (I) a. (generally at the end of a compound) 1. Like, similar, e.g. तरुणादित्यसंकाशम्; 2. near, close, at hand.
संकाश (II) m. Appearance, presence, vicinity.
संकिल m. A burning torch, a fire-brand.
संकीर्ण (I) a. (f. र्णा) 1. Confused, crowded, miscellaneous; 2. indistinct; 3. scattered, diffused; 4. of mixed caste, of impure origin; 5. contracted, narrow.
संकीर्ण (II) m. 1. A man of a mixed caste; 2. a mixed mode or note (in music); 3. an elephant in rut.
संकीर्ण (III) n. 1. A difficulty; 2. an enemy.
संकीर्ण (I) a. (f. र्णा) 1. Confused, crowded, miscellaneous; 2. indistinct; 3. scattered, diffused; 4. of mixed caste, of impure origin; 5. contracted, narrow.
संकीर्ण-योनि a. of a mongrel breed (as a mule).
संकीर्तन n. 1. Praising, applauding; 2. singing the praise of a deity; 3. repeating the name of a deity as an act of devotion.
संकीर्तना f. 1. Praising, applauding; 2. singing the praise of a deity; 3. repeating the name of a deity as an act of devotion.
संकुचित a. (f. ता) 1. Contracted, shrunk, wrinkled; 2. closed, unblown.
संकुचित a. (f. ता) 1. Contracted, shrunk, wrinkled; 2. closed, unblown.

संकेत (I) m. 1. Sign, gesture, intimation, hint; 2. agreement, convention, तत्रानंत्यात्संकेतः कर्तुं न युज्यते K.Pr.ii.; 3. engagement, appointment, assignation; 4. condition, provision; 5. a short explanatory rule (in grammar).
संकेत (II) n. Rendezvous.
संकेतक m. 1. Rendezvous; 2. agreement, convention; 3. appointment, assignation; 4. a lover or mistress, who meets by assignation, संकेतके चिरयति प्रवरो विनोदः Mrich.iii.
संकेतित a. (f. ता) Fixed by convention, साक्षात्संकेतितं योऽर्थमभिधत्ते स वाचकः K.Pr.ii.
संकेतित a. (f. ता) Fixed by convention, साक्षात्संकेतितं योऽर्थमभिधत्ते स वाचकः K.Pr.ii.
संकोच (I) m. 1. Contraction, shrinking; 2. terror, fear; 3. abridgment, diminution; 4. shutting up, closing; 5. a kind of skate-fish.
संकोच (II) n. Saffron.
संक्रंदन m. An epithet of Indra.
संक्रम (I) m. 1. Going together, concurrence; 2. transit, transition, progress; 3. the passage of a planetary body through the zodiacal signs; 4. moving, travelling.

संक्रम (II) m.n. 1. Difficult passage or progress; 2. a bridge, a causeway, e.g. नदीमार्गेषु च तथा संक्रमानवसादयेत्; 3. a means of effecting a difficult passage or attaining an object, सोऽतिथिः स्वर्गसंक्रमः Panch.iii.
संक्राम m. The same as संक्रम q.v.

संक्रमण n. 1. Concurrence; 2. transition from one body to another; 3. the sun’s passage from one sign of the zodiac to another; 4. the first day of the summer solstice; 5. a certain class of problems (in algebra).
संक्रांत a. (f. ता) 1. Passed through or into, entered into; 2. transferred; 3. depicted, imaged.
संक्रांत a. (f. ता) 1. Passed through or into, entered into; 2. transferred; 3. depicted, imaged.

संक्रांति f. 1. Going or meeting together, union; 2. passage from one point to another; 3. the passage of the sun through the zodiacal signs; 4. transference, imparting, पयसो गंडूषसंक्रांतयः Ut.iii., विवादे दर्शयिष्यंतं क्रियासंक्रांतिमात्मनः Mal.i.; (hence) 5. the power of teaching or transference, संक्रांतिरस्य य विशेषयुक्ता Mal.i.; 6. reflection; 7. imitation.
संक्लेद m. 1. Moisture, damp; 2. the rudiment of the foetus, its form in the first month after conception.
संक्षय m. 1. Complete destruction or consumption; 2. loss, ruin; 3. destruction of the world; 4. end.
संक्षिप्ति f. 1. An abridgment; 2. throwing, sending; 3. ambuscade.

संक्षेप m. 1. Throwing together; 2. abridgment; 3. conciseness; 4. taking away; 5. assisting in one’s duty; 6. a brief exposition, an epitome.(संक्षेपेण and संक्षेपतस् are used as indeclinables in the sense of ‘concisely, briefly, in short.’)
संक्षेपण n. Contraction. See संक्षेप.
संक्षोभ m. 1. Trembling, agitation; 2. disturbance; 3. overturning, upsetting; 4. pride, arrogance.
संख्य n. War, battle, कथं भीष्ममहं संख्ये योत्स्यामि मधुसूदन Bg.ii.4.

Doubt, uncertainty, suspense; 2. risk, danger, सर्वत्रार्थार्जुनो प्रवृत्तिः ससंदेहैव Hit.i; 3. rhetorical doubt proceeding from the close resemblance of two objects; (according to some authorities, the name of this figure is ससंदेह) (ससंदेहस्तु भेदोक्तौ तदनक्तौ च संशयः K.Pr.x.), for examples, See Bh.V.iv.33, 34, 35.
संदेह-दोला f. the swing of uncertainty, a dilemma.
संदोह m. 1. Quantity, assemblage, multitude, नयनादंदसंदोहतुंद्दिलीकरणक्षमा Bh.V.iv.9; 2. milking.
संद्राव m. Flight, retreat.
संधा f. 1. Agreement, promise, ततार संधामिव सत्यसंधः R.xiv.52; 2. intimate union; 3. state, condition; 4. stipulation; 5. limit, boundary; 6. steadiness, fixedness; 7. twilight; 8. distillation.

संधान n. 1. Uniting, joining, यदर्थे विच्छिन्नं भवति कृतसंधानमिव तत् Sak.i.; 2. mixing; 3. fixing (as an arrow), tying, binding, का कथा बाणसंधाने Sak.iii.; 4. peace, alliance, e.g. कृष्णो ज्ञातीन् समानाय्य स संधानं करिष्यति; 5. association, union; 6. joint, e.g. पादजंघयोः संधाने गुल्फः; 7. something eaten to excite thirst; 8. distillation of liquors; 9. a kind of spirituous liquor; 10. contracting the skin by astringent applications; 11. pickles; 12. soar rice-gruel; 13. support.
संधानित a. (f. ता) 1. Strung together; 2. bound, tied.
संधानित a. (f. ता) 1. Strung together; 2. bound, tied.

संधि m. 1. Union, junction, गत्वा चोर्ध्वं दशमुखभुजोच्छ्वासितप्रस्थसंधेः Megh.i.58; 2. alliance, peace, treaty, संधिः सर्वमहीभुजा विजयिनामस्तु प्रमोदः सदा Hit.iv., पतेः संधिं न कुर्वीतविगृह्णीयात्तु केवलम् Hit.iv.; (this is one of the six means of dealing with an enemy); 3. a joint, an articulation of the body, समुद्गतस्वेदचितांगसंधयः Rt.i.7; 4. a fold; 5. euphonic union of letters (in gram.); 6. a period at the expiration of each Yuga; 7. an interval, a pause; 8. a hole, a chasm, a breach, (especially in a wall for felonious purposes), संधिं छित्त्वा तु ये चौर्यं (कुर्वंति) M.ix.276; 9. division, quarter; 10. vulva; 11. critical juncture, opportune moment.
संधि-अक्षर n. a diphthong.
संधि-चौर m. a thief who breaks into a dwelling, a house-breaker.
संधि-जीवक m. one who lives by dishonest means (especially as a go-between).
संधि-दूषण n. the violation of a treaty or alliance, (क्षितीशाः) विदधति सोपधि संधिदूषणानि Kir.i.45.
संधि-बंधन n. joint, bending, ligament.
संधि-भंग m. dislocation of a joint.
संधि-मुक्ति f. dislocation of a joint.
संधि-विचक्षण m. an able negotiator of treaties.
संधि-वेला f. twilight.
संधि-हारक m. a house-breaker.
संधिक f. Distillation of liquors.
सांधिक m. A distiller.
संधित (I) a. (f. ता) 1. Tied, bound; 2. united; 3. reconciled; 4. pickled.
संधित (II) n. 1. Pickles; 2. spirituous liquor.
संधित (I) a. (f. ता) 1. Tied, bound; 2. united; 3. reconciled; 4. pickled.
संधिनी f. 1. a cow in union with a bull; 2. a cow milked unseasonably, e.g. न पिबेत्संधिनीक्षीरम्.
संधिला f. 1. A breach or hole in a wall, a chasm, a pit; 2. spirituous liquor; 3. a river; 4. a house.
संधुक्षण n. 1. Inflaming, kindling; 2. exciting.
संधुक्षित a. (f. ता) 1. Inflamed, kindled; 2. excited.
संधुक्षित a. (f. ता) 1. Inflamed, kindled; 2. excited.
संधेय a. (f. या) 1. To be reconciled, सुजनस्तु कनकघटवत् दुर्मेद्याश्चाशु संधेयः Hit.i.; 2. to be entered into alliance with.
संधेय a. (f. या) 1. To be reconciled, सुजनस्तु कनकघटवत् दुर्मेद्याश्चाशु संधेयः Hit.i.; 2. to be entered into alliance with.

संध्या f. 1. Twilight (either morning or evening), कुर्वन् संध्याबलिपटहतां शूलिनः श्लाघनीयाम् Megh.i.34; 2. the period between the expiration of one age and the commencement of another, M.x.69; 3. the morning, noon or evening prayers of a Brāhmaṇa, M.ii.69; 4. thinking, meditation; 5. promise, agreement; 6. joining, onion; 7. boundary; 8. a kind of flower; 9. the name of a river; 19. name of a wife of Brāhmaṇa (m.).
सांध्य a. (f. ध्यी) Relating to the twilight, अथ सांद्रसांध्यकिरणारुणितम् Sis.ix.15, Kir.v.8.
संध्या-अभ्र n. 1. an evening cloud, संध्याभ्रलेखेव मुहूर्तरागा Mrich.iv.; 2. a sort of red chalk.
संध्या-नाटिन् m. an epithet of Śiva.
संध्या-पुष्पी f. a kind of jasmine.
संध्या-बल m. demon.
संध्या-राग m. red lead.
संध्या-राम m. an epithet of Brahman (m.).
सन्नकद्रु m. The Piyāla tree.
सन्नति f. 1. Reverence, salutation; 2. humbling, humiliating; 3. a kind of sacrifice; 4. a sound.

सन्नद्ध a. (f. द्धा) 1. Bound, girdled on; 2. dressed in armour, mailed; 3. harnessed; 4. arranged, arrayed, कः सन्नद्धे विरहविधुरां त्वय्युपेक्षेत जायाम् Megh.i.8; 5. well-provided with anything; 6. closely attached, bordering, near; 7. prevalent, कुसुममिव लोभनीयं यौवनमंगेषु सन्नद्धम् Sak.i.

सन्नद्ध a. (f. द्धा) 1. Bound, girdled on; 2. dressed in armour, mailed; 3. harnessed; 4. arranged, arrayed, कः सन्नद्धे विरहविधुरां त्वय्युपेक्षेत जायाम् Megh.i.8; 5. well-provided with anything; 6. closely attached, bordering, near; 7. prevalent, कुसुममिव लोभनीयं यौवनमंगेषु सन्नद्धम् Sak.i.
सन्नय m. 1. Quantity, number, multitude; 2. rear, rear-guard.
सान्नाय्य n. Any substance with clarified butter and offered as a burnt offering.
सन्नहन n. 1. Arming, equipping; 2. industry, exertion; 3. binding tightly.
सन्नाह m. 1. Armour, mail, e.g. शीलसन्नाहरक्षिताः साध्व्यः; 2. arming for battle.
सन्नाह्य m. A war elephant.

सन्निकर्ष m. 1. Bringing or drawing near; 2. proximity, presence, स्त्रीसन्निकर्षं परिहर्तुमिच्छन् K.S.iii.7, R.vii.84; 3. connection, relation; 4. connection of an organ of sense with its object (in Nyāya philosophy).
सन्निकर्षण f. 1. Approximating, approaching; 2. proximity.
सन्निकृष्ट (I) a. (f. ष्टा) Approximate, adjacent.
सन्निकृष्ट (II) n. Proximity, vicinity.
सन्निकृष्ट (I) a. (f. ष्टा) Approximate, adjacent.
सन्निधातृ m. 1. A receiver of stolen goods, M.ix.276; 2. officer who introduces people at court.
सन्निधान n. 1. Placing down together, juxtaposition; 2. proximity, presence; 3. perceptibility, appearance; 4. a receptacle; 5. receiving, taking charge of.
सन्निधान n. 1. Placing down together, juxtaposition; 2. proximity, presence; 3. perceptibility, appearance; 4. a receptacle; 5. receiving, taking charge of.

सन्निपात m. 1. Falling down, alighting, descending; 2. a musical tune or measure; 3. contact, collision, नानारत्नज्योतिषां सन्निपातैः Kir.v.36; 4. assemblage, multitude, एको हि दोषो गुणसन्निपाते निमज्जति K.S.i.3; 5. morbid state of the three humours of the body producing fever and dangerous illness (in medicine); 6. arrival; 7. union, junction; 8. mixture, miscellaneous collection, धूमज्योति सलिलमरुतां सन्निपातः क्व मेघः Megh.i.5.
सन्निपात-ज्वर m. fever produced by the vitiation of the three humours of the body.
सन्निबंध m. 1. Tying firmly; 2. attachment, connection; 3. effectiveness.
सन्निभ a. (f. भा) (at the end of compounds) Similar, Rt.i.11.
सन्निभ a. (f. भा) (at the end of compounds) Similar, Rt.i.11.
सन्निवृत्ति f. 1. Return; 2. restraint, forbearance.

सन्निवेश m. 1. All open place in the vicinity of a town where people take exercise; 2. place, R.vi.19; 3. assemblage, multitude; 4. construction, fabrication, रमणीय एष वस्तुमनसां सन्निवेशः M.M.i.; 5. convening, causing to gather, क्रियतां समाजसनिवेशः Ut.vii.; 6. situation, position, posture; 7. form, figure, अहो सुलभानुकारः खलु वेधसो जगति निर्माणसन्निवेशः Kad.; 8. vicinity.
सन्निहित a. (f. ता) 1. Placed near, proximate, close at hand; 2. present, अपि सन्निहितोऽत्र कुलपतिः Sak.i.; 3. deposited, fixed, laid up; 4. prepared, ready.
सन्निहित a. (f. ता) 1. Placed near, proximate, close at hand; 2. present, अपि सन्निहितोऽत्र कुलपतिः Sak.i.; 3. deposited, fixed, laid up; 4. prepared, ready.
सन्निहित-अपाय a. transitory, fleeting, liable to destruction, कायः सन्निहितापायः Hit.i.
संन्यसन n. 1. Abandonment of all worldly affections, न च सम्न्यसनादेव सिद्धिं समधिगच्छति Bg.iii.4; 2. entrusting to.
संन्यस्त a. (f. स्ता) 1. Laid down, placed down; 2. entrusted, consigned; 3. relinquished, abandoned.
संन्यस्त a. (f. स्ता) 1. Laid down, placed down; 2. entrusted, consigned; 3. relinquished, abandoned.

संन्यास m. 1. Abandonment; 2. abandoning all worldly affections and possessions and fixing the mind on the supreme being, M.i.114, 108; 3. deposit, trust; 4. a stake in game; 5. giving up the body, death; 6. Indian spikenard.

संन्यासिन् m. (fem. ˚नी) 1. One who lays down or deposits; 2. one who has abandoned all worldly affections, ज्ञेयः स नित्यसंन्यासी यो न द्वेष्टि न कांक्षति Bg.v.3; 3. a Brāhmaṇa in the fourth Āśrama, an ascetic.
संपत्ति f. 1. Prosperity, success, e.g. संपत्तौ च विपत्तौ च महतामेकरूपता; 2. excellence of qualities; 3. a kind of medicinal root.
संपाति m. Name of a fabulous bird, brother of Jaṭāyu.

संपद् f. 1. Success, prosperity, e.g. संपदि यस्य न हर्षो विपदि विषादो रणे च भीरुत्वम्; 2. blessing; 3. richness, plenty, सस्यानामिव संपदः R.x.59, K.S.v.27; 4. wealth, power, आपन्नार्तिप्रशमनफला संपदो ह्युत्तमानाम् Megh.i.53; 5. accomplishment, perfection, excellence, excess, Sis.ix.1; 6. advancement in good qualities; 7. adornment; 8. a necklace of pearls; 9. treasure.
संपद्-वर m. a king, a prince.
संपन्न (I) a. (f. न्ना) 1. Successful, fortunate, thriving; 2. finished, completed; 3. full-grown, mature; 4. right, correct; 5. endowed with, possessed of; 6. made of, become; 7. obtained, acquired.
संपन्न (II) m. An epithet of Śiva.
संपन्न (I) a. (f. न्ना) 1. Successful, fortunate, thriving; 2. finished, completed; 3. full-grown, mature; 4. right, correct; 5. endowed with, possessed of; 6. made of, become; 7. obtained, acquired.
संपराय m. 1. War, battle; 2. calamity; 3. futurity; 4. a son.
सांपराय (I) a. (f. यी) 1. Relating to war, warlike; 2. relating to the other world, future.
सांपराय (II) m.n. 1. Contention, conflict; 2. the future, the future life; 3. means of attaining a future world; 4. investigation; 5. uncertainty.
संपराय(यि)क n. War, battle.
संपराय(यि)क n. War, battle.
सांपरायिक (I) a. (f. की) 1. Military, strategic; 2. warlike; 3. calamitous; 4. relating to the other world.
सांपरायिक (II) m. A war-chariot.
सांपरायिक (III) n. War, battle.
संपर्क m. 1. Mixture; 2. copulation; 3. union, society, न मूर्खजनसंपर्कः सुरेंद्रभुवनेष्वपि Bhartr.ii.14; 4. contact, त्वत्संपर्कात् पुलकितमिव प्रौढपुष्पैः कदंबैः Megh.i.25.
संपाट m. A spindle.

संपात m. 1. Concurrence, butting together; 2. meeting; 3. descending, falling down, flashing; 4. alighting (as a bird); 5. flying (of arrows); 6. collection, प्रवृत्ते शस्त्रसंपाते धनुरुद्यम्य पांडवः Bg.i.20; 7. a special mode of flight attributed to birds; 8. going, moving; 9. being removed or displaced, M.vi.56.
संपाद m. 1. Completion, accomplishment; 2. obtaining.
संपादन n. 1. Accomplishment, effecting; 2. cleansing, M.iii.255; 3. attaining, acquiring.
संपीड m. 1. Pain, torture; 2. driving, sending, संपीडक्षुभितजलेषु तोयदेषु Kir.vii.12; 3. castigation, punishment; 4. squeezing, compression.
संपीडन n. 1. Pressing, squeezing; 2. castigation, punishment; 3. sending; 4. stirring, agitation.
संपीति f. Drinking in company.
संपुट m. 1. Cavity, सफेनलालावृतवक्त्रसंपुटम् Bt.i.21; 2. a covered box; 3. the kurabaka flower.
संपुटक m. A box, a casket.
संपुटका f. A box, a casket.
संपूर्ण (I) a. (f. र्णा) The same as पूर्ण q.v.
संपूर्ण (II) n. Ether.
संपूर्ण (I) a. (f. र्णा) The same as पूर्ण q.v.
संपृक्त a. (f. क्ता) 1. Mixed, blended; 2. connected, वागर्थाविव संपृक्ता R.i.1.
संपृक्त a. (f. क्ता) 1. Mixed, blended; 2. connected, वागर्थाविव संपृक्ता R.i.1.
संप्रक्षालन n. 1. Bathing; 2. inundation.

संप्रतिरोधक n. Actual confinement, imprisonment.
संप्रतीति f. 1. Fame, notoriety, Kir.iii.43; 2. compliance.
संप्रत्यय m. 1. Agreement; 2. firm conviction.
संप्रदान n. 1. The act of giving or handing over completely; 2. gift, donation, bestowal; 3. bestowing in marriage; 4. the idea expressed by the fourth case (in gram.).
संप्रदानीय n. A gift, a donation.
संप्रदाय m. 1. Traditional doctrine; 2. a religious doctrine with exclusive worship of one divinity; 3. custom, usage.
संप्रधारण n. Determining the propriety or impropriety of anything, deliberation.
संप्रधारणा f. Determining the propriety or impropriety of anything, deliberation.
संप्रमोद m. Excessive joy.
संप्रमोष m. Loss, abstraction.

संप्रयोग m. 1. Union, meeting, कांतां विचिंत्य सुलभेतरसंप्रयोगाम् Mal.v., R.v.54; 2. mutual relation, proportion; 3. coitus, sexual union; 4. order, natural series; 5. contact, connection, एतेन मोचयति भूषणसंप्रयोगान् Mrich.iii.; 6. magic.
संप्रयोगिन् m. 1. A joiner; 2. a libertine; 3. a calamity; 4. a conjuror.
संप्रवृष्ट n. A rain-fall.
संप्रसाद m. 1. Favour, grace; 2. serenity; 3. trust, confidence; 4. the soul.
संप्रसारण n. The substitution of the vowels, इ, उ, ऋ, ऌ for य्, र्, ल, व् respectively (in gram.).
संप्रहार m. 1. Mutual striking; 2. conflict, war, battle.
संप्रीति f. 1. Attachment, affection, friendly regard; 2. delight.
संप्रैष m. 1. Sending away; 2. direction, command.
संप्लव m. 1. Surge; 2. submersion, inundation; 3. falling into ruin, ruin; 4. subversion.

संबंध m. 1. Connection, union; 2. relationship, relation; 3. fitness, propriety; 4. success, prosperity; 5. friendship, friendly connection, संबंधमाभाषणपुर्वमाहुः R.ii.58, K.S.vi.29.
संबंधक (I) a. (f. का) 1. Relating, concerning; 2. fit, suitable.

संबंधिन् (I) a. (f. नी) 1. Inherent, connected with; 2. belonging to; 3. possessing good qualities.

संबाध m. 1. The being thronged; 2. pressing on, pressure, स्तनसंबाधमुरो जघान च K.S.ii.26; 3. difficulty, impassableness, न केवलं भुवः पृष्ठे व्योम्नि संबाधवर्तिभिः R.xii.67; 4. the road to hell; 5. the vulva; 6. fear, dread.

संबोध m. 1. Explaining, instructing, informing; 2. loss, destruction; 3. right perception; 4. giving, sending.

संभग्न m. An epithet of Śiva.

संभावन n. 1. Adequacy, ability; 2. fitness; 3. possibility; 4. doubt; 5. considering, reflecting, R.v.28; 6. thought; 7. respect, honour, veneration, संभावनागुणमवोहि तमीश्वराणाम् Sak.vii.; 8. love.
